1.translation: By the night when it covers[1],
1.footnotes: [1] Everything between sky and earth with its darkness.

2.translation: and by the day when it appears,

3.translation: and by His creation of male and female,

5.translation: As for the one who gives in charity and fears Allah,

6.translation: and truly believes in the best reward,

7.translation: We will make easy for him the way of salvation.

8.translation: But as for the one who is miserly and deems himself self-sufficient,

10.translation: We will make easy for him the way of perdition.

11.translation: His wealth will be of no avail to him when he tumbles [into Hell].

12.translation: Indeed, it is upon Us to show the right way,

13.translation: and surely to Us belong the Hereafter and the present life.

14.translation: So I warn you of a raging Fire,

15.translation: none will enter it except the most wretched,

17.translation: But the most righteous will be saved from it,

18.translation: who spends his wealth to purify himself,

19.translation: not in return for someone’s favors[2],
19.footnotes: [2] i.e., not as a repayment for a favor he received.

20.translation: but to seek the pleasure of his Lord, the Most High.

21.translation: He will surely be well pleased.
